meaningBrief.tension: A large opportunity conflicts with a smaller option that better supports long-term direction.
examples: A high-paying job repeats an old career pattern, while a lower-paying role develops needed skills.
Several appealing projects consume time needed for one important commitment.
A familiar business offer delays work on a new professional goal.
meaningBrief.pairBehavior: Jupiter increases opportunities and ambition, while the North Node identifies the direction that supports future development.
meaningBrief.aspectBehavior: The square creates a practical conflict between broad expansion and focused progress that persists until a clear choice is made.
meaningBrief.consequence: Similar setbacks or competing offers keep occurring until growth is directed toward the intended path.

draft.title: Jupiter square North Node
draft.body:
The biggest opportunity on the table may also pull us back into a life we already know. With Jupiter square North Node, options multiply faster than our sense of direction can sort them. A higher-paying job repeats an old career pattern; several exciting projects take time from one important commitment; a familiar business offer delays work on a new professional goal. Everything looks like growth, but only some choices develop what we will need next.

When we avoid choosing, the same conflict returns in a different form. We take on more, lose time for the work that matters, and meet another appealing offer that recreates the same delay. Once we commit to a direction, the useful opportunity becomes easier to recognize and act on. The smaller option may pay less or impress fewer people, but it can build the skills and momentum our long-term direction requires.

judge.weakest: Once we commit to a direction, the useful opportunity becomes easier to recognize and act on.
judge.why: The source meaning is accurate, but the second paragraph shifts into flat strategy language and resolves the tension through generic advice rather than a vivid, pair-specific observation. The example beat also reads as three summarized scenarios instead of quick concrete fragments.

naturalnessJudge.rationale: One sentence uses an awkward construction that makes the reader pause to interpret what the choices are developing.
